content: Lecture notes on the initial-value problem, polar coordinates and orbital plane coordinates, representation in the hodograph plane, flight-direction angle, Lagrange coeﬃcients in terms of the true anomaly diﬀerence, Lagrange coeﬃcients in terms of the eccentric anomaly diﬀerence, Lagrangian coeﬃcients for parabolic orbits, solving the generalized form of Barker’s equation, and construction of a parabola and its tangents.
